author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Can a robot baptized?  It turns out water is never the problem.
I chatted with GPT a whole argument on this theology question, the essay version is too dry and boring, so I ask GPT to write me a funny Sci-fi story instead.  What if the AGI that rules the world says it believes in Jesus?

shared_article.title: An AGI Accepts Jesus, and Christianity Has a Problem
